programmes.d: Cyril inherits an Irish castle, where water from the Well of Doon is said to cure all ailments. To preserve the well for the inhabitants of the city, Cyril has to fight against an inheritance claim of rich businessman, Ron Blackard.
On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh'lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers...
In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn't bargain for...
Rikki uses her abilities as a mermaid to earn some quick cash, but when she accidentally becomes involved in a fish smuggling operation, she sets out to get her revenge.

Rikki enters a short film contest on the theme of 'Heroes' and decides to capture some nice underwater footage with her 'abilities'. Meanwhile, Emma is interviewing her mum and Zane and Lewis are planning to rennact Dr. Bennet's windsurfing record.

Byron asks Emma for help with training the school's swimming team and Emma has some trouble deciding whether or not to help out in her current situation. Meanwhile, Lewis continues to experiment on the girls, which annoys Rikki.

Rikki sets Cleo up at a karaoke contest as a joke, where she is humiliated due to her lack of talent. However, her singing ability undergoes a dramatic change when, in spite of the girls' precautions, she is hypnotized by the full moon.
When the mysterious, old Miss Chatham's boat and home is declared unseaworthy, Emma invites her over to stay. Zane gets trapped on the sinking boat and Emma tries to save him but he sees a tail.

Cleo's 16th birthday is approaching and she thinks that her father is going to throw another embarrasing birthday party. Meanwhile, Zane tries to find the 'sea monster' that he saw when he almost drowned.

Emma is put in charge of managing the juice bar. Miriam decides to cause trouble and cuts the power to the cool room, then is unwittingly frozen by Emma who uses her powers to fix the freezer. Will the girls be able to thaw Miriam out?
Kira and Zyro battle in a floating stadium. As the battle rages, a robotized Doji enters and interrupts the match.
Gingka, Zyro and Kira team up to defeat Doji, and the WBBA wins the right to chart the course for the future of Beyblade.
An undefeated Blader named Zyro Kurogane travels to a big city, where he loses his first battle to a famous Blader by the name of Shinobu Hiryuin.
Zyro tires of training and challenges Eight to bey battle in the Cyclone Beystadium.
Benkei sponsors a one-day bey tournament, where Zyro defeats Shinobu in the final to avenge his earlier loss.
Zyro battles Kite and defeats him, but in a rematch, Kite claims victory to even the score.
Salem is terrified to learn that the evil Toc-Toc is being released from suspended animation (a Netherworld corrections facility) for a crime Salem committed!

Sabrina and Maritza unsuccessfully try to convince Cassandra that littering isn’t cool. The trash in Greendale is so bad, that these “best friends for life” get their favorite skateboard star, Ricky Speed, to come and perform and clean up the pollution.
Sabrina is excited when Maritza asks her to go to the Plain Brain concert, but when her aunts invite her on a trip to the hyper spa at the same time as the concert.
Tim the Witchsmeller is a disgruntled half witch who can perform no magic, and boy is he bitter.
Salem eats Sabrina's prize mouse for her science fair exhibit. After much blackmailing on Sabrina's part, she gets Salem to morph into a mouse to take its place.
Archie is temporarily unable to type, so Reggie offers to write the Weird Mystery article for the school paper.
A monstrous man of incredible strength is making evening appearances in Riverdale.
Betty begins to mysteriously receive fortune cookies that instruct her to carry out simple good deeds each of which leads to a reward.

Charlotte takes over and organises a surprise party for Lewis, annoying Rikki. At the party, Charlotte is jealous of Cleo and traps her and Emma in a pool room. Rikki comes back just in time. From now on, Charlotte is on her own.

Cleo is bullied by Charlotte and runs away to the ocean. With Cleo missing, everyone becomes more and more worried. Lewis discovers what Charlotte has been up to and breaks up with her. He finds Cleo and they kiss.

The full moon rises, and with the planets lining up, it can remove mermaid powers for good. Knowing this, Lewis lures Charlotte to the moon pool but it backfires and Emma, Cleo and Rikki all look set to lose their powers.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: The Awakening
programmes.d: Cleo and Rikki face their final year of high school without Emma. They make a new friend in Bella and meet new boy Will – and encounter a strange new force on Mako Island that turns water against them.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Jungle Hunt
programmes.d: Will seeks confirmation of his first experience on Mako Island. Bella volunteers to misdirect his search so he won't find the Moon Pool. The girls and Lewis discover the Moon Pool has changed.
Marshall uncovers a plot by a new school nurse, who's using an eye exam to hypnotize students to make them worker drones incapable of having fun.
Marshall and a friend each want to win the heart of the same girl, who has a heart condition that brings her to Eerie hoping to have a transplant.
Gary is like any other 14-year old boy yearning for some privacy.
Selfish eight year old Shauna doesnt like to share, especially with her five year old sister Katie.
The Enchanted School gets more than they expected when their new Librarian arrives. Aside from his immense knowledge of books, Professor Begelboyce brings tales of fantastic exploits.

Cassy is doing a report for Wish Giving Class when a powerful force from center-earth steals all her visual aides. We learn right away that it's Zarlak. He has coerced the legendary Ring of The Blue Moon.
After Scott and his rock band perform a song on a televised talent show, Scott is discovered by a record label that wants to sign him.
Scott visits his cousin, Todd, but the two have nothing in common. As Scott tries to help Todd come out of his shell, he realizes that he and his cousin are much more alike than he initially thought.

Scott's family album of werewolves gets mixed up in the back of Mick's car. He and his friend Stiles hunt it down in order to protect the Howard family secret.
Scott and his family mysteriously become unable to control their wolf-outs and worry that the town monster, that has been covered in recent news reports, is actually them.

Scott's werewolf family comes to town for a family reunion. Scott's cousin, Eva, goes on a date with Mick, and it's Scott's responsibility to protect the family secret before it's revealed that Eva is a werewolf.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: The Incredible Shrinking Teens
programmes.d: Archie and Jughead accidentally shrink themselves in a shrink machine at a local Mad Scientist convention.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Little Chock'lit Shoppe Of Horrors
programmes.d: In an attempt to make Pop's Chock'lit Shoppe more efficient, Dilton installs some high-tech labor-saving devices which ultimately conflict with Pop's personal attention policy.

'Pink-Anderthal Man': Manly Man pursues the Panther through the ages. 'Pink Kong': Despite strong opposition from Voodoo Man, the Panther helps Queen Kong realize her dream of becoming a famous torch singer in New York City.

'Moby Pink': Pinky accidentally stows away on a broken-down fishing scow, skippered by an old salt searching for a great 'off-white' whale. 'The Pink Stuff': Pinky wants to be the first to walk on Mars, but Astronaut Avery Bravery has other ideas.
Outraged by a popular song about Sonic, Robotnik outlaws music on Mobius and takes the song's composer captive with the intent of creating his own song.
An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.
Inspector Gadget, with the help of his niece Penny, stops M.A.D. agents from stealing gold from the ancient City of Gold and uncovering a real gold temple.

In an M.A.D. movie, Inspector Gadget saves the military secrets from falling into M.A.D.'s hands by taking the part of a knight, starring opposite the famous Lana Lamour (an M.A.D. agent in disguise).

Mr. Bean makes his own horror movie and ropes in Mrs. Wicket as the star! Mr. Bean is unimpressed with a horror movie he sees at the cinema and reckons he can do much better. Bean sets out to create his very own home movie masterpiece.
Mr. Bean has to look after Mrs. Wicket’s goldfish, but Scrapper the cat is keen to ‘help’. Mr. Bean has to look after Mrs. Wicket’s pet goldfish while she is away.
Mr. Bean wins tickets for a Cruise, but if only he could stay on it! Mr. Bean wins two tickets for an exotic cruise and naturally, he takes Teddy along for the trip of a lifetime.

Mr. Bean hopes to win some cash prizes at the funfair, but it’s not as easy as it seems! Mr. Bean goes to his favourite china shop to buy a new cup for Teddy, but when he opens his wallet he doesn’t have enough money to pay for it.

Mr. Bean’s electricity is cut off so he builds a wind turbine – all fine until there’s too much wind! Mr. Bean’s electricity supply is cut off when Mrs. Wicket sees the cost of her enormous electricity bill.
When a disgruntled employee steals an ancient Dragon Flute from a Toronto Museum, he uses its legendary powers to render crowds of people unconscious.
